changes: Removed cross-block Lagrangian coordination (benders.coordinate), the outer loop, block lower/upper bounds and closure skipping, planes, outer_history and coordination_upper; master() became hard_rows() (fixed bits and cut-free block QUBOs byte-identical to 3d3fa3e on four instances)
One persistent BlockSearch per block for the whole run; cuts and dispatch cache survive across rounds
Bounded retention: the QUBO encodes at most 64 feasibility cuts (least slack at the anchor), each block stores at most 4096 cuts FIFO, the cache keeps compact records

Block-search prices apply only to cross rows with continuous columns (ramp, end-of-block shutdown capacity, cold start), at the continuous-relaxation duals; pure-binary cross rows are priced 0 and enforced through the incumbent
Options max_outer/max_inner replaced by max_rounds; removed option names are rejected as unknown
Only TimeoutError maps to TIME_LIMIT; LLM local feasibility is None without block searches; partition rejects rows without coefficients; optimize takes IntFeasTol explicitly
An exact-oracle Lagrangian phase (Gurobi block MIQP + box trust-region bundle) was implemented and then removed; it remains in Git history (62b8deb, a8100fb)

findings.coordination_defect: Old coordination was CAPPED on every recorded call (RCUC20 probe 52/52, IEEE118 probe 29/29, 2026-10-21 IEEE118 run 44/44, v0.33.0 11/11); multipliers never left the LP duals because planes came from SA/repair points, not block minimizers, so the cutting-plane model overestimated the dual by 2-7.5%
findings.lagrangian_bound: With exact Gurobi block oracles the Lagrangian bound equalled the reference optimum on RCUC20 and classic10 and was 0.043% below it on IEEE118 (TIME_LIMIT after 119 s, 19 iterations)
findings.removal_reason: Every lower bound in the project (continuous relaxation, exact Benders master, Lagrangian) is computed by Gurobi; SA only yields upper bounds. The Lagrangian phase was slower than solving the full problem with Gurobi and showed no UB benefit, so v1.0.0 evaluates against the Gurobi reference only
findings.unbounded_qubo_growth: Without the cut cap, persistent RCUC20 block QUBOs grew from 361 to 2227 bits within 90 s (SA call 0.07 s -> 0.62 s)

limitations: Single seed (17) and a single 600 s run per group, three instances run in parallel; UB differences are not evidence of better or worse
The three code versions differ in several ways at once (coordination removal, persistent searches, cut cap, pricing rule)
Reference optima are used only for after-the-fact comparison
runtime_source_hash_format: SHA256 of exact working-tree bytes at release time; Git source archive may normalize text line endings
